ex.s: At least 80 inches of rain a year is normal-and in some areas there may be as much as 430 inches of rain annually.

ex.s: When we look out of the window and see rain or snow, we can say “it’s raining” or “it’s snowing”.

defs.def: to fall or to make sth fall on sb/sth in large quantities （使）大量降落，雨点般落下

ex.s: Airplanes seed threatening storm cells with a chemical to make small ice crystals fall as rain before they can grow into dangerous hailstones.
ex.t: 飞机向有威胁的风暴云团播撒一种化学物质，使小冰晶在长成危险的冰雹之前就以雨的形式落下。
